verdict.rationale: The evidence shows behavioral cohorts can be created, listed, exported and uploaded (docs-6, docs-29), and charts and dashboards can segment users and build funnels (docs-5, docs-18). However, no item explicitly documents a retention analysis or chart that tracks retention over time, so the core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit retention-over-time chart documentation, evidence that retention can be broken down by behavioral cohort, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
